page_title: ATM 5-2 RMA | Atletico Madrid v Real Madrid 27/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Javier Alberola has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) receives a yellow card for infringement.
90+5' It's like he was asking for a caution. Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) receives a yellow card.
90+3' 5 - 2 Goal! Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot into the bottom right corner.
90+2' Substitution. Julian Alvarez will be replaced by Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid).
90+2' Substitution. Alex Baena has come on for Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid).
90+1' Rodrygo (Real Madrid) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Jan Oblak, who smothers the ball.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
89' Dean Huijsen comes off the pitch to be replaced by Gonzalo Garcia (Real Madrid).
89' Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

88' Close effort! Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) takes the resulting free kick from a promising distance, but he sends it narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
87' Referee Javier Alberola sees the trip by Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Real Madrid get a free kick.
84' Federico Valverde (Real Madrid) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
83' Diego Simeone has decided to substitute Nicolas Gonzalez and he is replaced by Antoine Griezmann (Atl. Madrid).
83' It is time for a substitution. Javi Galan (Atl. Madrid) is on for David Hancko.
82' Javier Alberola shows a yellow card to Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) for a tough tackle.
79' A cross from Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
78' Javier Alberola blows his whistle. David Hancko (Atl. Madrid) commits a foul after dangerous play. It's a free kick to Real Madrid, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
76' That's unlucky! Rodrygo (Real Madrid) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
74' Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play. The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick.
73' Alvaro Carreras (Real Madrid) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
71' Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Javier Alberola saw the whole situation. Atl. Madrid have a free kick.
70' Substitution. Rodrygo (Real Madrid) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Jude Bellingham walks off.
69' The game is interrupted now, Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
69' There's an opportunity for Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
68' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) makes a rough challenge and Javier Alberola blows his whistle for a foul. Real Madrid win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Conor Gallagher (Atl. Madrid) replaces Alexander Sorloth.

63' 4 - 2 Free kick from the edge of the penalty box. Ideal position for a player with brilliant shooting technique . And that is no one else than Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid), who perfectly curls the ball into the back of the net. Beautiful football moment.
63' Atl. Madrid are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
62' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
62' The foul by Alvaro Carreras (Real Madrid) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Javier Alberola.
59' Xabi Alonso prepares a substitution. Arda Guler is replaced by Franco Mastantuono (Real Madrid).
59' It's time for a substitution. Eduardo Camavinga (Real Madrid) comes on in place of Daniel Carvajal.
59' A superb shot by Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) after a mid-range free kick! His attempt, however, flies just over the crossbar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
58' Raul Asencio (Real Madrid) is awarded a yellow card for his tackle. He doesn't seem to agree with the decision, but Javier Alberola ignores the protests.
57' Real Madrid seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
56' Javier Alberola shows the yellow card to Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) for a heavy challenge.
53' Alvaro Carreras (Real Madrid) commits a rough challenge and Javier Alberola blows his whistle for a foul. Atl. Madrid are awarded a free kick.
51' 3 - 2 Goal! Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Thibaut Courtois into right side of the goal.
51' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
50' Javier Alberola shows a yellow card to Arda Guler (Real Madrid), who isn't surprised as the tackle was really hard and late.
50' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Javier Alberola blows for a foul. It's a penalty for Atl. Madrid!
49' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is about to take a corner kick.
49' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. The ball is out of play and Atl. Madrid manage to earn a corner.

48' Alvaro Carreras (Real Madrid) commits a rough foul. Javier Alberola stops the game and makes a call. It's a free kick to Atl. Madrid, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
47' Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
47' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

46' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball is out of play. Atl. Madrid will have a chance to score from a corner.
46' Xabi Alonso has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Raul Asencio (Real Madrid) comes on the pitch for Eder Militao.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+9' Javier Alberola blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+8' David Hancko (Atl. Madrid) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Real Madrid.
45+6' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. Atl. Madrid will take a free kick.
45+6' Alvaro Carreras (Real Madrid) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
45+5' Javier Alberola couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Koke (Atl. Madrid) and blew his whistle. It's a free kick to Real Madrid in a dangerous position.
45+3' 2 - 2 Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header inside the left post. Excellent finish.

45+2' The ball goes out of play and Atl. Madrid will have a goal kick. Arda Guler (Real Madrid) takes a shot after receiving a good pass, but his effort from the edge of the box goes just over the crossbar.
45' 7 additional min. will be played.
45' Celebrations are cut short for Atl. Madrid as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was handball!
44' The Atl. Madrid players halt their celebrations as referee Javier Alberola makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was a handball in the build-up play.

44' The ball hits the back of the net! Julian Alvarez delivers the corner, Clement Lenglet (Atl. Madrid) finds himself some space on the edge of the box and unleashes an unstoppable shot which goes inside the left post and past the helpless goalkeeper. 2:2.
43' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

42' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team. That's a free kick to Atl. Madrid.
40' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) sees a yellow card from Javier Alberola after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
40' Daniel Carvajal (Real Madrid) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
40' Javier Alberola blows for a foul after Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball. Real Madrid will take a free kick near the side line.

39' OFF THE POST! Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the right post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky. The ball goes out of play and Real Madrid will have a goal kick.
36' 1 - 2 Goal! Vinicius Junior slips it to Arda Guler (Real Madrid) on the edge of the box and he lashes the ball low into the middle of the net. The score is 1:2.
35' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) will try to find the head of one of his teammates from a corner kick.
35' Vinicius Junior (Real Madrid) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. Real Madrid force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
32' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) tries to find Kylian Mbappe, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Atl. Madrid.
25' 1 - 1 Kylian Mbappe (Real Madrid) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and drills the ball into the bottom left corner. Magnificent finish!
24' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

23' Nicolas Gonzalez (Atl. Madrid) unleashed a monstrous piledriver. He controlled a pass, glanced up at goal and shot from the edge of the box. It could have been a difficult one for the keeper, but the ball fortunately hit one of the defenders and ball bounced away. The referee points to the corner flag and Atl. Madrid will take a corner.
22' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) gets booked for the first time in this match.
22' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Thibaut Courtois.
20' Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
18' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Javier Alberola blows his whistle for a foul. Atl. Madrid win a free kick.
18' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it.
17' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
14' 1 - 0 Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) scores from a seemingly difficult position as he leaps high to head home a cross, putting the ball beyond the reach of the goalkeeper.
13' Jude Bellingham (Real Madrid) was too forceful with his tackle and Javier Alberola interrupted the game to signal a free kick. Atl. Madrid have been awarded a free kick.
12' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will swing the ball into the penalty box.

11' Alexander Sorloth (Atl. Madrid) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the roof of the net is denied by a decent save from Thibaut Courtois. Atl. Madrid earn a corner.
10' The Real Madrid players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
8' Arda Guler (Real Madrid) crosses the ball into the box from the free kick, but the defence clears the danger.
7' Javier Alberola blows the whistle, Robin Le Normand (Atl. Madrid) is penalised for a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Real Madrid.
7' A pass from Giuliano Simeone (Atl. Madrid) is intercepted by Thibaut Courtois and the move breaks down.
5' Eder Militao (Real Madrid) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
1' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) steps up to send the ball in.

1' Julian Alvarez (Atl. Madrid) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Atl. Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Atl. Madrid will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Javier Alberola.
Show lineups You can have a look at the starting XIs of both teams in the details of this match.
Show lineups
